SELECT count(0) FROM b_xiecheng_colliding_data_loop_cycle
WHERE (push_time > CURDATE() and create_time < CURDATE()) or (release_time >= CURDATE() AND release_time < CURDATE() + INTERVAL 1 DAY AND (release_time < #{begin,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} OR release_time > #{end,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}) AND is_delete = 0)

SELECT COUNT(0) FROM b_xiecheng_colliding_data_loop_cycle
WHERE release_time >= date(#{begin,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}) AND release_time < DATE_ADD(date(#{begin,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}), INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND (release_time < #{begin,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} OR release_time > #{end,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}) AND is_delete = 0

select count(0) from (select cell_sha256_code_list as cell from b_xiecheng_colliding_data_loop_cycle where release_time >= #{begin,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} AND release_time <= #{end,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} and is_delete = 0) cycle inner join (${scoreSql}) score on cycle.cell = score.cell

SELECT
COUNT(CASE WHEN cycle.release_time >= date(#{timeRangePlus.begin,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}) AND cycle.release_time < DATE_ADD(date(#{timeRangePlus.begin,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}), INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND (cycle.release_time < #{timeRangePlus.begin,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} OR cycle.release_time > #{timeRangePlus.end,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}) THEN cycle.cell_sha256_code_list END) as ${prefix}_#{timeRangePlus.order},
FROM b_xiecheng_colliding_data_loop_cycle cycle
WHERE cycle.release_time >= date(#{minBegin,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}) AND cycle.release_time < #{maxEnd,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} AND cycle.is_delete = 0

SELECT
COUNT(CASE WHEN cycle.release_time BETWEEN #{timeRangePlus.begin,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} AND #{timeRangePlus.end,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} THEN cycle.cell_sha256_code_list END) as ${prefix}_#{timeRangePlus.order},
FROM b_xiecheng_colliding_data_loop_cycle cycle INNER JOIN b_xiecheng_colliding_${batchNumber} sc on cycle.cell_sha256_code_list = sc.cell and sc.is_delete = 0
and (${sqlCondition})
where cycle.release_time >= #{minBegin,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} AND cycle.release_time <= #{maxEnd,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} and cycle.is_delete = 0
